business_profile.business_overview: Little Arabia Restaurant is an Arabian restaurant in Shantinagar, Dhaka (141 Shantinagar, Dhaka-1217) offering free home delivery across the city with its own delivery service. They operate an official website for ordering. Orders are taken via phone/website with no WhatsApp ordering bot, despite WhatsApp being Bangladesh's dominant messaging platform.
business_profile.offer_surface: Autonomous AI agent deployment for Restaurant with home delivery — targeting: WhatsApp order bot that takes orders, confirms menu items, and provides delivery ETA; Automated order-status updates eliminating inbound status calls; Repeat-customer engagement with personalized offers and re-order prompts; Peak-hour order management to prevent missed calls during lunch/dinner rush

pricing_knowledge.model: Restaurant menu + free home delivery (own fleet)
pricing_knowledge.note: Own delivery fleet means they keep margin but bear order-intake load. A WhatsApp order bot + status updates would cut phone friction during peak hours and drive repeat orders — high-leverage for a delivery restaurant.

business_profile.competitive_position: Little Arabia competes with other Dhaka restaurants and aggregators. Their edge is free home delivery with their own fleet. But phone-only ordering loses customers to restaurants with smoother ordering. A WhatsApp order bot would make ordering frictionless and drive repeat business.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With free city-wide delivery and an own fleet, order volume is significant. If phone-only ordering loses customers during peak hours and there's no repeat-order engagement, that's lost revenue on both acquisition and retention. A WhatsApp order + status + re-order agent recovers this.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. WhatsApp order bot taking orders, confirming items, giving delivery ETA.
2. Automated order-status updates eliminating inbound calls.
3. Repeat-customer engagement with personalized offers.
4. Peak-hour order management.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A customer messages Little Arabia on WhatsApp at 8pm dinner rush: '2 chicken biryani + 1 khabab to Dhanmondi.' The AI confirms the order, gives a 40-min ETA, and sends a status update when it's out for delivery. The customer re-orders the next week via a personalized prompt. Little Arabia handled a peak-hour order and drove a repeat — zero phone calls.
